{{Quote|Hardly! It broke when we evacuated the Princess of Quanducial down the palace wall!|Thame Cerulian's comment in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'', about a grappling hook's tested breaking point of 550 kilograms|<ref name="TJP" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the '''Princess of Quanducial'''<ref name="TJP" /> and shared their title with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Quanducial system/Legends|Quanducial system]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> during the last [[Standard year/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. On one occasion during their [[Time/Legends|time]] at that position, they had to be [[Evacuation of the Princess of Quanducial|evacuated]] from their residence and received help from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thame Cerulian]], who intended to lower the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] down the wall of the palace by using a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]]. Despite having the tested breaking point of 550 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], however, the device broke during the attempt. Cerulian later recorded the event in his copy of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Princess of Quanducial was mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a [[2010]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TJP" />
